purpose: Control one concrete research execution instance from dispatch audit through startup gates, substantive work, handoff/return, Driver review, recovery and closure. This machine controls execution legality; it does not promote mathematical truth.

authority_and_scope.rule: Scheduler/taskbook/identity/candidate states remain separate dimensions. No other state surface may silently advance this execution instance.

UNBOUND.meaning: An execution record exists, but the taskbook has not yet passed the current dispatch audit.

DISPATCH_READY.meaning: The exact taskbook revision passed current dispatch audit and may be bound to a concrete execution.

CLAIMED.meaning: A concrete conversation/execution has accepted the task but identity/startup requirements are not yet fully resolved.

IDENTITY_READY.meaning: Role identity is locally resolved. The execution must now classify and satisfy all task-declared pre-math gates.

PRE_MATH_GATES_PENDING.meaning: At least one task-declared PRE_MATH gate lacks durable verified evidence.

EXECUTION_READY.meaning: Identity and all PRE_MATH gates are satisfied; task-whitelisted substantive work may begin, subject to later gate-ledger action guards.

IN_PROGRESS.meaning: Substantive work has begun under the taskbook whitelist and current execution gates.

HANDOFF_READY.meaning: A durable handoff exists. This execution instance does not continue substantive work unless explicitly resumed in the same conversation; a new conversation creates/binds a new execution identity.

RETURNED.meaning: A durable research return exists; the execution awaits Driver review.

DRIVER_REVIEW_PENDING.meaning: Driver is reviewing the durable return and its evidence.

RETURN_ACCEPTED.meaning: Driver accepted the return as a valid completion of this execution. This does not by itself promote theorem/candidate/canonical truth and does not imply a successor task.

RETURN_REJECTED.meaning: Driver rejected this execution return or found it non-compliant; any further attempt is a new or explicitly resumed execution according to routing policy.

RECOVERY_REQUIRED.meaning: Chat/runtime continuity is unreliable or stale. Durable repository evidence must be reconciled before any further substantive work.

REDISPATCH_REQUIRED.meaning: This execution cannot be safely resumed; Driver/scheduler may create a fresh execution without changing mathematical truth.

NONSTART_TERMINAL.meaning: A mandatory startup/pre-math gate failed before mathematics. This is an execution/liveness outcome, not a mathematical verdict.

CLOSED.meaning: This execution instance is closed after Driver review and parent/successor routing evaluation.

action_classes.CONTROL_PLANE_READ: Read governance/taskbook/startup material expressly allowed before mathematics.
action_classes.STARTUP_WRITE: Create identity/evidence/branch/stamp artifacts required by a startup gate.
action_classes.MATHEMATICAL_SOURCE_READ: Read a mathematical input, theorem packet, proof source or other task mathematics.
action_classes.MATHEMATICAL_DERIVATION: Perform substantive mathematical reasoning, computation, experiment or formal proof work.
action_classes.CHECKPOINT_WRITE: Persist progress/evidence without terminating the parent objective.
action_classes.RETURN_WRITE: Persist the research return/handoff required by the taskbook.
action_classes.DRIVER_REVIEW: Review evidence and route the execution outcome.

execution_gate_contract.gate_ledger_rule: Every declared execution gate is instantiated as PENDING for the concrete execution. Only durable evidence satisfying the gate's evidence contract may move it to SATISFIED. A failed gate remains FAILED until Driver-authorized recovery/re-dispatch or an explicitly permitted same-execution repair.
execution_gate_contract.action_guard_rule: An action is legal only if both the current execution state allows the action class and every declared gate whose must_precede contains that action is SATISFIED. State permission alone never bypasses an unsatisfied gate.
execution_gate_contract.pre_math_rule: If any declared gate has phase=PRE_MATH, the execution must enter PRE_MATH_GATES_PENDING after identity resolution and may reach EXECUTION_READY only after every PRE_MATH gate has durable verified evidence.
execution_gate_contract.mid_execution_rule: MID_EXECUTION gates do not prevent entering EXECUTION_READY unless they name a mathematical action that occurs immediately; they block each listed must_precede action at the point of use until SATISFIED.
execution_gate_contract.pre_return_rule: PRE_RETURN gates must include RETURN_WRITE in must_precede and therefore prevent RETURN_ARTIFACT_PERSISTED until SATISFIED.
execution_gate_contract.no_gate_rule: If execution_gates is empty, IDENTITY_READY may transition directly to EXECUTION_READY after startup classification.
execution_gate_contract.evidence_rule: A chat statement, progress message, intention, local-only unverified write or oral completion claim is never durable gate evidence.
execution_gate_contract.failure_rule: Failure of a mandatory PRE_MATH gate transitions to NONSTART_TERMINAL or RECOVERY_REQUIRED/REDISPATCH_REQUIRED as applicable; it never manufactures a mathematical verdict. Failure of a later gate blocks the guarded action and must be recovered, repaired if authorized, or returned as an execution failure rather than silently bypassed.

premath_directive_detection.purpose: Catch obvious prose-only startup gates that were omitted from machine-readable execution_gates.
premath_directive_detection.rule: If taskbook body matches one of these obvious task-local patterns but declares no PRE_MATH gate, dispatch audit fails EX-PREMATH-UNDECLARED. Driver semantic review remains responsible for equivalent wording not caught lexically.

recovery_transitions.reconcile_rule: Recover from durable repository evidence only. Determine the last legal state and gate ledger whose required evidence actually exists; do not infer completion from chat text.

cross_surface_invariants: Scheduler CLAIMED/IN_PROGRESS/DONE coordinates task leasing only and cannot by itself advance this execution state.
Taskbook base_state=READY is not equivalent to EXECUTION_READY; identity and PRE_MATH gates still apply.
Identity REGISTER_PENDING is nonblocking once a valid local role identity exists, but identity must be resolved before substantive work.
Axiom-candidate promotion and canonical theorem truth are separate from RETURN_ACCEPTED. A valid negative/null result may be RETURN_ACCEPTED.
CHECKPOINT_PERSISTED and progress messages are nonterminal under active_turn_liveness.json.
A local-stage PASS or accepted return triggers parent/successor evaluation; it never automatically creates a successor task.
Any mathematical source read or derivation while state is PRE_MATH_GATES_PENDING is an illegal execution transition and invalidates independence/liveness claims that depend on that gate.
Any action listed in an unsatisfied execution gate's must_precede is illegal even when the current state would otherwise permit that action class.
Any claimed state advance without the transition's required evidence is invalid and must be reconciled to the last evidenced legal state and gate ledger.
A failed PRE_MATH publication/liveness gate is classified as execution failure, not mathematical failure.
A new conversation after handoff/redispatch must run identity bootstrap again and bind a new execution instance unless repository policy explicitly preserves the same conversation identity.

f5a_regression_guard.scenario: Researcher reports completion but mandatory pre-math remote branch/stamp evidence is absent.
f5a_regression_guard.reason: Oral/chat completion cannot satisfy a durable PRE_MATH publication-liveness gate.
